# Traceability Matrix

Build or update a requirements traceability matrix (RTM) as a CSV or spreadsheet that links business objectives to requirements, user stories, design items, test cases and their status, and report the gaps: requirements with no test, tests with no requirement, objectives with no requirement, and changed requirements whose tests were not updated. Use when preparing for sign-off, UAT or an audit, or when scope changes and the team needs to see what is affected.
